The R&D Lab opened. First run coming up.

formatLeads.name: Weapon Ball Battle (HP bars)

example.title: Levi vs Eren | Weapon Ball Battle #shorts
example.creator: Cell Wars Game
example.vsAvg: 3.2x channel avg (Seadog Ball Battles also 1,143 at 3.0x and 1,061 at 2.8x)

formatLeads.howToMake: New sims.py format: two balls bounce in an arena, each with a weapon drawn on it (sword, spear, hammer, shield). A hit on the other ball takes HP; health bars on top; winner gets a slow-mo finish. Use generic weapons and names only, never anime/Minecraft characters (copyright).
formatLeads.why: Three separate small channels are 3x outliers with the same 'X vs Y ball battle' idea, and mobile games built on it exist (Weapon Ball Fight on the App Store). It fits Omar's 'who escapes / who wins' winners (pick-a-colour Shorts 1.4K-3.2K).

formatLeads.name: Character balls (meme names, 'vs')
formatLeads.howToMake: Same physics as his escape/battle sims, but each ball gets a face and a meme-style name ('Sigma Ball' vs 'Tiny Ball'); title is 'A vs B'. Faces are simple shapes drawn in sims.py.
formatLeads.why: Giving the balls a personality turns a sim into a rivalry viewers pick a side in; 1.2M views at 3.5x.

formatLeads.name: Stacking until it falls (0% → 1,000,000%)
formatLeads.howToMake: 2D rigid-body stacking in sims.py (pymunk or his own physics): drop generic phones/boxes/blocks one at a time onto a tower with a counter (1, 10, 100...) until it collapses. Never show brand logos.
formatLeads.why: Counter + inevitable collapse is a pure wait-for-it hook; 3.6M views in 6 days.

formatLeads.name: Marble run course (10+ minutes)

example.title: Marble Run ☆ Freedom Marble Run①
example.creator: Marble Run Freedom
example.vsAvg: 10.7x channel avg (also Marble corn 2,020,488 at 19.6x; サマーマーブル 1,031,777 at 4.8x)

formatLeads.howToMake: A long 2D marble course built from his marble-race and 'escape' pieces: funnels, spinners, elevators, drop gates, one camera that follows the leader. One continuous run, calm music from his synth, no talking. Note: the examples are filmed physical runs, so this is a sim version of a proven long-form demand, not a copy.
formatLeads.why: Marble runs are the biggest long-form outliers in the niche right now, while Omar's own longs peak at 114 views. His Shorts marble races already pull 1.4K-3.8K.

formatLeads.name: Spanish-title 'elige tu color' race

example.title: CARRERA DE CANICAS ELIGE TU COLOR FAVORITO!!
example.creator: FernanWarriorZ

formatLeads.howToMake: No new build: take his best marble race ('Fastest marble wins 🏁 Pick one', 3,827 views) and upload one version with a Spanish title and on-screen text ('¡Elige tu color!'). Visuals have no words, so one text change localises it.
formatLeads.why: Wordless sims travel across languages; a Spanish marble race is a 3.4M-view 5.7x outlier. Cheap test of a new audience.

formatLeads.name: AI-visual afterlife story ('A day in Jannah')

example.title: Aik Din Jannat Main | AI Movie Of Heaven
example.creator: SA Religious Voice
example.vsAvg: about 7,000x the channel's typical video; its 'AI Movie of Jahannam' is 131K at 82x

formatLeads.howToMake: English 15-25 min long: calm AI voice narrates what the Quran and sahih hadith describe about Jannah (every claim with its ayah/hadith reference on screen), over AI-generated or stock landscapes (gardens, rivers, light), with his soft rain/ambience bed underneath. Never depict prophets, angels or Allah; no reciter audio. Have the script checked against the sources before upload.
formatLeads.why: Long Islamic storytelling with AI visuals is the biggest outlier found in his niche; it gives Ambient Escape a long format with search demand, while his recitation longs get 0-21 views.

formatLeads.name: Second-person Jannah reminder
formatLeads.howToMake: Text Short in his existing Islamic Short template: 'You walk through the gates of Jannah...' lines appear one by one over a calm landscape, ending with the source (e.g. Quran 39:73) and a dua line. Optional AI voice.
formatLeads.why: OutlierKit credits the 'you are there' framing and an ending call to dua. Omar's own Quran-verse Shorts already get very high like rates (93:3 Short: 1,334 views, 125 likes, 96% watched).

formatLeads.name: Question hook reflection

example.title: The Question That Leaves Every Soul Silent
example.creator: Tartil Offical

formatLeads.howToMake: Open with a question on screen ('What will you say when you are asked about your youth?'), pause 2 seconds, then the ayah or hadith that answers it, with the reference. Same text template he already uses.
formatLeads.why: Question-led Islamic titles beat statement reminders in the trending data, and it costs nothing to switch hooks.

formatLeads.name: AI macro nature + ayah

example.title: What Happens When a Strawberry Falls in the Rain? 🌧️🍓🌱
example.creator: Nature & Noor AI

formatLeads.howToMake: Slow AI or stock macro clip (rain on fruit, a seed sprouting) with a 'what happens when...' title, then an ayah about rain or growth as text, over his rain audio. Do NOT copy their reciter audio (Content ID).
formatLeads.why: Curiosity title + calming nature visual is a cheap way to make Islamic Shorts look different from plain text cards. Weaker evidence (2.1x), so test only.

tiktok.title: 'It's making sense now' reaction format
tiktok.what: React to someone's bad reasoning with a calm 'it's making sense now' realisation; 206 creators this week, +20,500%.
tiktok.howToUse: Sit-down version: 'Why most guys can't stop scrolling... it's making sense now' then explain the psychology in 3 beats. Pairs with the psychology-facts angle the team already picked.

tiktok.title: Stoic one-liners are 30x outliers on Shorts
tiktok.what: One strong line about desire/discipline, dark minimal visual.

evidence.title: You become free the moment your desires stop controlling you.
evidence.creator: hiddenverses

tiktok.howToUse: Open a talking video with one quotable line (Islamic or stoic) as the first sentence and on-screen text, then explain it in under 40 seconds.

tiktok.title: 'Editing how I see myself' moodboard
tiktok.what: Aesthetic self-image edit, new this week (68 creators).
tiktok.howToUse: Optional B-side post: a quick moodboard of who he's becoming (gym, Quran, books, desk) with one line of text. Only if it doesn't need filming beyond phone clips he has.

youtube.title: Change one visible thing in every remix
youtube.what: A third-party report says YouTube cut reach from Oct 1, 2026 for re-uploads without meaningful additions, and calls template uploads with minimal changes more exposed.

evidence.title: What Does YouTube's October 2026 Original-Content Shorts Update Mean

youtube.howToUse: Keep the remix rule strict: a new colour, count, arena or melody every time, never the same render with a new title.
